title: GetSetGo
description:
We have been attending so many meetups and workshops happening around the ETHIndia week. One thing we have noticed is that many people aren't paying attention to what the speaker is saying.
"So...What can we do to engage the people around", we thought. Hence we came up with an idea of building an interactive platform like kahoot, but with an option for the organizers to stake some tokens as the prize money and the top performers get rewarded automatically through a smart contract.
how_its_made:
By the time of the deadline, we could only complete the project,partially, that includes:
- Smart Contract Deployment
- Integrated basic UI for the Smart Contract
- Admin Dashboard: For adding the quiz questions and managing the prize distribution.
